swappath.description: Swap path: location where swapspace may create and delete swapfiles.

lower_freelimit.description: Lower free-space threshold: percentage of free space below which additional swapspace is allocated.

upper_freelimit.description: Upper free-space threshold: percentage of free space above which swapspace will attempt to free up swapspace.

freetarget.description: Percentage of free space swapspace should aim for when adding swapspace.

min_swapsize.description: Smallest allowed size for individual swapfiles.

max_swapsize.description: Greatest allowed size for individual swapfiles.

cooldown.description: Duration (roughly in seconds) of the moratorium on swap allocation or cooldown time after successful allocation.
